plugins.name: media
plugins.title: Media
plugins.description: Edit a video or a photo with the agent: mark where something is wrong on the frame, and the agent trims, cuts, sets exposure, speed and volume, crops and turns it, then renders the result.
plugins.tagline: Mark what's wrong on a frame; the agent trims, cuts and crops the video or photo.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants to edit a video or a photo, to show you a moment or a spot in one, or to choose between takes, clips or photos by playing or looking at them

plugins.name: google-docs
plugins.title: Google Docs
plugins.description: Edit a Google Doc with the agent: it proposes changes, comments and replies, you approve them or type in the doc yourself, and Send puts them in Docs as suggestions.
plugins.tagline: The agent proposes edits and comments on a Google Doc; you approve what goes in.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants to write, edit or review a Google Doc, or answer its comments

plugins.name: neo-manuscript
plugins.title: NeoManuscript
plugins.description: Write LaTeX in Source or Visual mode, where headings, math and references show as they'll look. The PDF builds as you type (latexmk with MacTeX, or Tectonic), errors link to their lines, and double-clicking the PDF jumps to the source. Markdown files get the same modes and a live preview. The agent reads the document and edits it with you.
plugins.tagline: A LaTeX and Markdown editor with a live PDF, which your agent can edit with you.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants to write or edit a LaTeX or Markdown document, such as a paper, and see its PDF or preview as it changes

plugins.title: GitHub
plugins.description: The issues and pull requests of a workspace's GitHub repository in a tab beside the chat: find, read, comment on, review and merge them, and hand one to the agent to work on, review, or fix a failing check.
plugins.tagline: A workspace's GitHub issues and pull requests in a tab; hand one to the agent.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user works on a GitHub repository's issues or pull requests, such as reviewing a pull request, seeing what waits for their review, or fixing a failing check
